Book correction: The answer key (PDF 305) prints S_n = \frac{2 - (n + 1)x^{n} + 2nx^{n+1}}{(1 - x)^{2}}: the factor 2 is missing on the (n + 1)x^n term. With n = 1, x = 2 it gives 6 instead of the first term 2. Correct: S_n = \frac{2[1 - (n + 1)x^{n} + nx^{n+1}]}{(1 - x)^{2}}.
